task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to the left arm activates the rounded square-shaped alarm clock by clicking the top button
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性不变形，进入框架左手臂点击顶部按钮即可激活圆角方形闹钟
